title: Managing Privacy Settings for End Users, Managers, and Approvers

blocks.text: On the User Portal page, you can override the privacy settings for the different data types for the end users, as well as the managers and approvers that were set during the configuration of all the DLP application integrations for your organization. These privacy settings control which types of incident data are visible to the end users, managers, and approvers when they are responding to end user notifications or escalation notifications they receive for an incident. If you override the privacy settings, the system uses these privacy settings to determine the types of incident data that are visible for the incidents, and it ignores the privacy settings configured for the data types for all the DLP application integrations for your organization.

To learn more about configuring privacy settings for the different data types for the DLP application integrations, see Configuring the DLP Application Integration Using Amazon Web Services, Configuring the DLP Application Using Azure, and Configuring the DLP Application Using Google Cloud Platform.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Workflow Automation > User Portal. The User Portal page appears, displaying the different data types (Evidence Data, Trigger Data, Policy Details, and Policy Details - Non-Triggered Matches) without any privacy settings configured for those data types for the end user, or the manager and approver.

Click the Override link at the top of the page. The Override Data Privacy Settings dialog window appears, displaying a message that states that changing this setting overrides integration-level data privacy, allowing both global and granular data access definition, and asking whether you want to continue.
Select the privacy settings for all the different data types that are displayed for the end user and the manager and approver by selecting one of the following options:
You cannot select the privacy settings for the Policy Details - Non-Triggered Matches data type, unless the privacy setting for the Policy Details data type is set to Show or Custom.
Show: The data is visible to the selected type of user role (e.g., end user or manager and approver).
Hide: The data is hidden from the selected type of user.

Custom: The data is visible to the selected type of user only for incidents that belong to one or more of the incident groups you configure on this page. For incidents that contain incident groups that are not configured on this page, the data is hidden. To configure the custom setting:
Select Custom. An incident group field appears.
From the incident group drop-down menu, select one or more incident groups. All the incident groups that exist on the Incident Group page are available for selection.
If you do not configure a privacy setting for a data type, the system uses the DLP application integration setting by default for that data type.

blocks.text: If you have previously overridden the privacy settings, you can choose to reset the privacy settings back to the DLP application integrations privacy settings.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Workflow Automation > User Portal. The User Portal page appears, displaying the overridden privacy settings for the different data types (i.e., Evidence Data, Trigger Data, Policy Details, and Policy Details - Non-Triggered Matches) for the end user, and the manager and approver.

Click the Reset link at the top of the page. The Reset Settings? dialog window appears, displaying a message that states that resetting will restore settings to their original integration-level defaults, and asking whether you want to continue. The Reset link is only available on the page if you have previously overridden the DLP application integration privacy settings.
The privacy settings for the different data types are reset. The User Portal page reappears, with no privacy settings configured for any of the data types.
